{{Top|leg}}
'''Readjustment camps''' were youth camps run by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Commission for the Preservation of the New Order/Legends|Commission for the Preservation of the New Order]]. Youth whose parents were sympathizers with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] were sent to the camps to be [[Imperialization/Legends|indoctrinated]] on Imperial [[New Order/Legends|philosophy]].
